source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of biotechnology and genetic engineering (PDF 155).

blocks.text: 'Biotechnology' ka matlab hai hayatiyat par mabni technology: jandaron, hayati amal ya nizamon ka aisi cheezein banane mein istemal jo insani zindagi aur mahol behtar karein. Is ka maqsad tib (medicine), zaraat aur sanat ke paicheeda masail hal karna hai. Yeh chapter is ke sab se ahem hisse, genetic engineering, ke baare mein hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Riwayati biotechnology hazaron saal se fermentation (khameer) mein roti aur paneer jaisi ghizaen banane ke liye use hoti aa rahi hai. Jadeed biotechnology 20vin sadi mein DNA ki banawat ki daryaft aur jadeed molecular tareeqon ke baad saamne aayi.

blocks.title: Genetic engineering
blocks.text: Biotechnology aik wasee chhatri jaisi istilah hai, lekin is ka asal engine genetic engineering hai: jandar ke DNA ko badal kar us ki khasiyatein ya salahiyatein badalna, genes dal kar, nikal kar ya tabdeel kar ke, aur kabhi mukhtalif species ke darmiyan genes muntaqil kar ke.

blocks.prompt: Genetic engineering roti banane jaisi riwayati biotechnology se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Riwayati biotechnology jandaron ko jaise hain waise use karti hai (fermentation mein khameer); genetic engineering jandar ka DNA seedha badalti hai, genes dal kar, nikal kar ya badal kar.

items: Biotechnology: jandaron aur amal se mufeed cheezein banana.
Genetic engineering: genes dal kar, nikal kar, badal kar ya muntaqil kar ke DNA badalna.
